name: AWS — Administrator Privilege Granted via AttachUserPolicy
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("AttachUserPolicy","AttachRolePolicy","AttachGroupPolicy","PutUserPolicy","PutRolePolicy")
| filter xdm.event.description contains "AdministratorAccess" or xdm.event.description contains "PowerUserAccess" or xdm.event.description contains "iam:*"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as attaches,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: AttachUserPolicy, AttachRolePolicy, AttachGroupPolicy, PutUserPolicy, or PutRolePolicy event with requestParameters containing AdministratorAccess, PowerUserAccess, or iam:* — broad IAM privilege grant.
alert_name: AWS — Administrator Privilege Granted via AttachUserPolicy

TA0004 - Privilege Escalation: T1098.003 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Roles
